name: Standard Constant Step Ray Marching
definition: A method for finding the intersection of a ray with an implicit surface by sampling the surface function at fixed intervals along the ray. It mitigates the drawback of root-finding methods that may find multiple intersection points by focusing on determining the first root.
summary: Standard Constant Step Ray Marching is a rendering technique that advances a ray by a fixed distance at each iteration, distinguishing itself from adaptive methods by using a static step size to avoid overshooting artifacts.
